notes:
Summary: Enterprise evaluation for full Private VPC deployment (primary ask: host inference in Helmshore VPC with strict egress controls). Key ask is network-first — PrivateLink preferred but open to peering for throughput-sensitive routes.

Decision makers: CTO (M. Alvarez), Head of Cloud Networking (S. Ko), InfoSec lead (L. Patel). Purchasing team: procurement + carrier-contracts group.

Requirements (high level):
- VPC connectivity: want PrivateLink endpoints for control-plane + peered subnets for high-throughput inference. Will test both during POC.
- Firewall & egress: central egress gateways with allowlists; must enumerate outbound FQDN/IPs and support proxy chaining. No unrestricted egress.
- IP allowlists: static egress IP range required for carrier firewall rules; need confirmation of NAT egress addresses and failover behavior.
- KMS integration: prefer customer-managed keys (BYOK) in AWS KMS; must support key rotation and provide proof of key usage in logs.
- Audit logging & retention: full request/response audit logs for 90 days in encrypted storage; integration with their SIEM (Splunk).
- Data residency: training data and embeddings must remain in NA regions, support for per-tenant region pinning.
- Latency/throughput: 95th percentile latency target <120ms for short-chat flows (<=256 tokens); spikes handled via Dedicated pool. Throughput target ~200 qps for reranking pipeline.
- Model preferences: open models (quantized) preferred for cost; fallback to higher-accuracy family for escalations. Must support automatic routing by policy.

POC plan agreed: 3-week POC starting 2026-03-20. Phases: network connectivity (week 1), KMS + logging (week 2), scale/latency tests (week 3). Success criteria: stable PrivateLink connectivity with documented egress IPs, KMS key operations verified, and <130ms 95p latency at 100 qps.

Conversation highlights (snippets):
- "We cannot open outbound ranges to the internet; every external call must be scannable and auditable." — L. Patel (InfoSec)
- "If you can give us deterministic NAT IPs and a simple CNAME pattern for health checks we'll be comfortable with PrivateLink." — S. Ko (Head of Cloud Networking)
- AE notes: SE intro call 2026-02-15 went deep on port mapping and proxy setup; asked for a prescriptive list of outbound hostnames and an architecture sketch.

Recent ask from them: example firewall rule set, sample CloudFormation/Terraform for VPC endpoints, and a KMS integration checklist. Sent initial draft security checklist (see drive link).

Open/legal items: procurement wants language around key custody and support for emergency key rotation; legal requested a data residency appendix for the contract.

- Security to share KMS BYOK playbook + audit format (by 2026-03-14) — SECURITY ENG
